Tasks and source finders¶

Tasks¶

For long-running operations the backend queues a task; the client polls for completion.

POST /v1/tasks/moment · POST /v1/tasks/pv¶

Same request body as the synchronous equivalents (/v1/products/moment, /v1/cube/pv); the dataset must be a cube (422 otherwise). Returns {valid, error, task_id, status: "running", cache_hit}.

GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}¶

{ "valid": true, "error": "", "task_id": "...", "operation": "moment",
  "status": "completed", "created_at": "…", "updated_at": "…",
  "progress": 1.0, "cache_hit": false, "result": { … } }

status is pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled. result holds the same payload as the synchronous route once the task has completed; error holds the reason of a failure. A task is visible only to the token that created it (404 for any other, as for an unknown id).

DELETE /v1/tasks/{task_id}¶

Request cancellation of a pending or running task: {cancelled, task_id}. 404 for an unknown task, 409 when it has already finished. Cancellation is best-effort: the task may still complete first.

BackendClient::waitForTaskCompletion() wraps the polling loop with exponential back-off.

Source finders¶

Source finders are plugins (backend/app/compute/finders) behind one interface: a finder writes a label mask (FITS on the dataset’s grid, 0 for background, n for the n-th source) and a VOTable catalogue, and returns the catalogue rows. Two ship with the backend:

Finder

Works on

Available when

sofia2

cube

the SoFiA-2 executable is found (VISIVO_SOFIA_BIN, or sofia2/sofia on PATH)

photutils

image

always

The list of available finders is also published in /v1/node/status.

GET /v1/finders¶

Every finder this node knows, available or not:

{ "finders": [
  { "name": "sofia2", "kinds": ["cube"],
    "description": "SoFiA-2 smooth-and-clip source finder for spectral-line cubes.",
    "parameters": { "scfind.threshold": "S/N threshold of the smooth-and-clip finder (default 5.0)", "…": "…" },
    "available": false,
    "reason": "SoFiA-2 executable not found (set VISIVO_SOFIA_BIN or put sofia2 on PATH)",
    "memory_factor": 2.3, "memory_floor_bytes": 134217728 } ] }

parameters maps each parameter a caller may set to a one-line description. memory_factor and memory_floor_bytes estimate a run’s memory as factor × dataset bytes + floor.

POST /v1/tasks/sourcefind¶

Run a finder as an asynchronous task.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "finder": "sofia2",
  "params": { "scfind.threshold": 4.0, "linker.minSizeZ": 3 } }

finder defaults to sofia2. For SoFiA-2, params keys are SoFiA’s own (section.key), limited to the pipeline, flag, scfind, threshold, linker, reliability, dilation and parameter sections; the input and output sections and the keys that name a file are refused, so a parameter can never make the node read a path of the caller’s choosing. For photutils they are nsigma (default 3.0), npixels (default 5) and connectivity (4 or 8, default 8).

Returns {valid, error, task_id, status: "running", cache_hit}. Refusals before the task starts: 404 unknown finder, 503 finder not available on this node, 422 wrong dataset kind. Poll with GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}; on completion result holds valid, error, dataset_id, finder, n_sources, sources (catalogue rows), mask_path and catalog_path (under <workspace exports>/sourcefind/<task_id>/), plus log_path for SoFiA-2 and threshold and noise for photutils. A run is limited to VISIVO_FINDER_TIMEOUT_S (default 3600 s); cancelling the task stops the finder process and removes its output directory.

The older synchronous route POST /v1/sourcefind/{dataset_id} is described under Spectral.
